message.reasoning:
We need to decide liquidation to pay rent owed 115, we have cash 22, shortfall 95. Options: mortgageable properties: ELECTRIC_COMPANY, WATER_WORKS (not owned), READING_RAILROAD, PENNSYLVANIA_RAILROAD, B_O_RAILROAD. We own READING_RAILROAD, ELECTRIC_COMPANY. Others not owned, can't mortgage. So can mortgage READING_RAILROAD (value? Typically railroads cost $200, mortgage value $100). Electric Company mortgage value $75? Actually utility mortgage $75. So total possible from mortgaging both: $100 + $75 = $175. That would cover. Also we have houses: ST_JAMES_PLACE 3 houses, TENNESSEE_AVENUE 3 houses, NEW_YORK_AVENUE 3 houses. Each property is part of a monopoly? ST_JAMES_PLACE, TENNESSEE_AVENUE, NEW_YORK_AVENUE are the orange set? Actually St. James Place, Tennessee Avenue, New York Avenue are orange. Yes we have monopoly with 3 houses each. Could sell houses: each house value is half purchase price. Purchase price: St. James Place $180, house cost $100? Actually houses cost $100 each on orange. So each house sells for $50. 3 houses each property = 9 houses total, each $50 = $450. That's a lot. But we have limited houses remaining 11, but we can sell. Selling houses reduces rent and may affect future. But we need cash quickly. Could also mortgage property after selling houses? But we need only 95. Best to sell some houses rather than mortgage? Mortgaging gives cash but also loses rent potential. Selling houses also reduces rent but we can keep property. Which is better? We have 3 houses on each of three properties. Selling one house from any gives $50. Need $95, so need to sell at least 2 houses ($100). That would give cash 122 (22+100). That covers owed 115. So we could sell 2 houses. Which houses? Could sell from any property. Might want to keep at least 1 house on each to maintain decent rent. So sell 1 house from two of the three. Choose maybe from ST_JAMES_PLACE and TENNESSEE_AVENUE. Or from the highest rent property? New York Avenue has highest rent with houses. Might want to keep houses there. So sell from ST_JAMES_PLACE and TENNESSEE_AVENUE. That yields $100.

Thus we will call sell_houses_or_hotel with sell_plan: two entries: space_key "ST_JAMES_PLACE", kind "HOUSE", count 1; space_key "TENNESSEE_AVENUE", kind "HOUSE", count 1.

Public message: maybe say "I'll sell two houses to cover rent." Could be neutral.

Private thought: reasoning.

Make tool call.
